text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — CS escalated ticket CS-9876: p99 latency jumped from ~500ms to 3.2s for a bunch of customers on Dedicated pools after the 04:00 deploy. They say generator requests time out (503) or take 3–5s. Logs show queueing at attach step.

Sachin Patel: Can you paste the sample request id and pool id? Also are these all the same model? :thinking:

Maya Chen: Sample request id: req_202631_X4, pool: dedicated-eu-gpu-7, model: gpt-open-13b-8k. Affected customers: 3 midsize apps. I see a pileup of attach/warmup attempts in the provisioning logs.

oncall-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T04:00 by linda-g - rollout to dedicated pools completed. Rollout id: r-7854. 

Linda Gómez: I pushed a hotfix to model packaging (kernel selector) in that rollout. Could be a perf regression during init. Reverting could be quick if needed.

Aaron B: From metrics: attach_time p95 went from 200ms -> 2.8s in dedicated-eu region immediately after deploy. Provisioning queue length spiked. Looks like autoscaler is hitting throttle and not starting new nodes fast enough.

Sachin Patel: Repro steps I ran locally: spin a burst of 200 concurrent attaches against a reserved pool with min_instances=0 and scale_policy=reactive; warmup time per GPU ~6–8s now vs 1.5–2s baseline. Kernel init appears serialized in new build.

Maya Chen: CS asked for mitigation asap — they want traffic routed away from affected pools. 

Aaron B: Short term: set min_instances on those customer pools to 1 and pin to older model build. Also create a routing rule to prefer hosted pools for these customers until we revert. I'll open the changes.

Sachin Patel: Commands I'm running:
```
# pin model version to pre-2026-03-17
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-eu-gpu-7 --min-instances 1 --model-version gpt-open-13b-8k@20260316
# add routing override for customers A,B,C
redwoodctl routing create --customer A --prefer hosted-eu
```

Linda Gómez: I'll prepare a revert PR for r-7854. If tests pass we can rollback and redeploy a gated build with parallel kernel init. 

Maya Chen: Aaron, can you also increase autoscale concurrency limit for the autoscaler to avoid throttle during bursts? Should be temporary.

Aaron B: Done — bumped scale-up throttle factor to 2x for eu region and increased concurrent-provisioners to 10. Monitoring now. 

oncall-bot: Alert resolved? p99 attach_time trending down to 700ms after config changes.

Support Bot: CS ticket updated: mitigations applied, awaiting confirmation from customers. 

Maya Chen: Thanks team. Next steps: Linda finish revert PR, Sachin run stress-tests against new revert build, Aaron monitor 24h and plan to restore conservative throttle after stabilization. I'll follow up with CS. :thumbsup:
